approver.description:
The only address that can approve listings, accept work and release payouts.
A human admin key in dev; a cw3 multisig or DAO-DAO core in prod. Never automatic.

creation_gate.description: Creation gate applied when no pre-propose module is installed. `serde(default)` = ProposerGate {}.

fee_bps.description: Fee taken from each payout, in basis points. Hard-capped at 1000 (10%).

min_duration_secs.description: expires_at must be within [now + min_duration_secs, now + max_duration_secs].

min_submit_stake.description:
Submission stake gate: the assignee's bonded-denom delegations must be >= this to `submit`.
0 disables the gate. Governance parameter (placeholder until voted).

min_upload_stake.description:
Upload stake gate for the off-chain CID storage service (terp-bounty-details/v1 and
terp-bounty-submission/v1 documents): the uploader's bonded-denom delegations must be >= this.
The contract does not see uploads; it is the governance source of the threshold and of the
`can_upload` check the service calls. 0 disables. Placeholder until voted.
`serde(default)` keeps configs stored by older code readable after a migrate.

owner.description: Can change config and the allowlist. DAO core address in prod.

params_placeholder.description: true while the parameters are PLACEHOLDERS that governance has not voted.

params_version.description:
Label of the governance parameter set in force (e.g. escrow/params/escrow.params.json
`params_version`). Stamped on every bounty and on create/update_config events.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_addresses_Addr
definitions.description:
A human-readable address.

In Cosmos, this is typically bech32 encoded. But for multichain smart contracts no
assumptions should be made other than being UTF-8 encoded and of reasonable length.

This type represents a validated address. It can be created in the following ways
1. Use `Addr::unchecked(input)`
2. Use `let checked: Addr = deps.api.addr_validate(input)?`
3. Use `let checked: Addr = deps.api.addr_humanize(canonical_addr)?`
4. Deserialize from JSON. This must only be done from JSON that was validated before
such as a contract's state. `Addr` must not be used in messages sent by the user
because this would result in unvalidated instances.

This type is immutable. If you really need to mutate it (Really? Are you sure?), create
a mutable copy using `let mut mutable = Addr::to_string()` and operate on that `String`
instance.

definitions.name: terp_bounty_escrow_state_ProposerGate
definitions.description: Who may propose (create) a bounty. A sender is eligible if ANY enabled gate passes.

cw4_group.description: cw4 group contract; sender must be a member with weight > 0.

min_stake.description:
Sum of the sender's delegations in the chain bond denom
(StakingQuery::AllDelegations + BondedDenom) must be >= this. Must be > 0 when set.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_uint256_Uint256
terp_bounty_escrow_state_CreationGate
definitions.description:
Who may create a bounty while the creation policy is `Anyone {}` (no pre-propose module).
When a pre-propose module is installed (`ProposalCreationPolicy::Module`), that module is the gate
and this setting is not consulted.

anyone.description: (a) Anyone may deposit and create a bounty. Listing still needs the approver.

counterparty_escrow_proof.description:
(c) TODO, NOT IMPLEMENTED: a sound, private proof that the proposer deposited into an escrow on a
counterparty chain (e.g. Zcash shielded) without revealing the deposit details. See DESIGN.md §9.
Instantiate/update_config reject it and create would fail with `Unimplemented`.

min_stake.description:
(b) The sender's bonded stake in the chain bond denom (same `bonded()` check as
`ProposerGate.min_stake` and the submit/upload gates) must be >= `amount`. `amount` > 0.

proposer_gate.description: Legacy behaviour: the `ProposerGate` (allowlist / min_stake / cw4, any passes).
